profile.headline: Lead Engineer at Capital One Shopping
profile.summary:
Talented full-stack developer with experience architecting, maintaining and refactoring large, scalable applications. I enjoy not only working with the latest technologies, but designing and creating them. I love deleting code almost as much as I enjoy writing it.

Specialties: JavaScript, jQuery, HTML, CSS, node.js, PHP, Regular Expressions, Software Architecture, Accessibility, Deleting Code

positions.title: Lead Front-End Developer
positions.description:
Despite my official title, I actually served as team lead/principal engineer, with a few years specifically as back-end lead.

Introduced agile development practices, resulting in greatly improved visibility into the upcoming work as well as the work currently being performed by the team.

Improved team communication and collaboration, eventually enabling us to hire remote employees, which now accounts for a third of our team.

Implemented code reviews and introduced automated testing and CI tools, resulting in much more robust and maintainable code.

Designed and implemented an integration to promote and sell deals through Groupon.

Nominated for corporate awards in problem solving and competency.

positions.title: Project Lead
positions.description:
Responsible for defining jQuery UI's roadmap, improving code quality and consistency, and keeping a distributed team of developers and designers active and focused on prioritized tasks.

Standardized API across all plugins and created a widget factory that defines the base functionality for all plugins, resulting in greatly reduced code duplication, faster development of new plugins, and improved ease of use and a smaller learning curve for end users.

positions.title: Team Member
positions.description:
Voting member of the jQuery project, responsible for determining the overall direction of the project and deciding when and how to spend money, time and resources.

Responsibilities included ticket triage, bug fixes, feature implementation, writing documentation, creating tests, task automation, infrastructure management, community outreach, FLOSS liaison, IP enforcement, and more.

positions.title: System Architect
positions.description:
Designed and implemented AmplifyJS, an open source JavaScript library, to solve problems commonly encountered in our client projects. AmplifyJS increases stability and consistency across appendTo's various projects while decreasing development time.

Worked with the Microsoft Patterns & Practices team to review and improve documentation and example code for Project Silk, a project which provides guidance for building cross-browser applications using the latest web technologies, such as HTML5, CSS 3, ECMAScript 5, and jQuery.

Provided feedback and direction for other developers on various client projects.

positions.title: Senior Front-End Developer
positions.description:
Improved testing efforts by creating a framework to facilitate automated full-page testing without the overhead of launching a browser; built on top of PHPUnit and phpQuery.

Spearheaded the removal of multiple JavaScript frameworks in order to standardize the application on jQuery, creating more consistent code for developers, faster page load times for users, and lower bandwidth costs for the company.

Improved consistency and validity of markup and styling throughout the application by identifying common UI patterns and creating Smarty functions to generate clean, semantic markup, resulting in DRY templates, faster development cycles, and better cross-browser compatibility.

Mentored other developers and improved code quality and consistency via pair programming, code reviews, improving and enforcing coding standards, presenting on various topics and setting up training events.

positions.title: Solutions Architect
positions.description:
Built a highly interactive front-end using advanced, cross-browser JavaScript and jQuery.

Created a SOAP API that supports versioning and a PEAR package that utilizes the API to allow rapid development of integrations with the WorkXpress engine.

Developed a robust application that handles all integration with eBay and PayPal using their respective APIs.

Introduced and championed testing with PHPUnit and created a build system utilizing Phing, phpDocumentor, and PHPUnit that ran daily.
